assumptions_and_limitations: Repository evidence is the only factual basis; no internet research, account access, secret access, or provider call was performed.
Root-cause grouping preserves every original blocker exactly once in blocker_records and treats downstream evaluator propagation as intentional traceability.
Provider facts are mutable; missing facts are classified as external evidence requirements, not inferred.
The matrix contains 11 independent root causes plus two propagated dependency groups that require explicit governed state reconciliation even though they add no new external fact.
This artifact is evidence-only and grants no approval, eligibility, runtime authority, or execution authority.
